themes.title: Trump’s Iran deal dominates global right-wing coverage
themes.blurb: Right-wing media across multiple countries are intensely covering President Trump's announcement of a 'largely negotiated' deal with Iran, which he claims will reopen the Strait of Hormuz. This theme reflects a shared focus on U.S. foreign policy and its perceived impact on global stability, with parallel reactions from leaders and commentators in Europe, the Americas, and the Middle East.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump's announcement of the Iran deal is the top story, with extensive coverage of negotiations, regional reactions, and potential implications for U.S. foreign policy.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Italian media highlights Meloni's cautious response to Trump's Iran deal, balancing support for U.S. diplomacy with concerns over regional stability and Italy's strategic interests.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Polish right-wing media frames the Iran deal as a pivotal moment for U.S.-Poland relations, emphasizing Trump's leadership and the potential for increased U.S. military presence in Poland.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Reform UK focuses on the geopolitical implications of the Iran deal, particularly its impact on energy markets and the UK's strategic interests in the Middle East.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Argentinian right-wing media covers the Iran deal as part of a broader narrative about Trump's global influence and Milei's alignment with U.S. foreign policy priorities.

themes.title: Far-right parties push 'national priority' policies
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right parties in Europe are increasingly advocating for 'national priority' policies, which prioritize citizens over immigrants in access to housing, social services, and employment. This theme reflects a transnational trend of anti-immigration rhetoric and policy proposals, with parallel developments in Spain, Italy, France, and Norway.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox continues to push 'national priority' policies in housing, social services, and employment, framing them as necessary to protect Spanish citizens from immigration and economic strain.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Italian right-wing parties, particularly Lega, are advocating for policies that prioritize Italian citizens in social welfare and housing, echoing Vox's rhetoric in Spain.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen's party is promoting 'national priority' policies in France, focusing on restricting social benefits for immigrants and prioritizing French citizens in employment and housing.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: The Progress Party in Norway is pushing for stricter immigration controls and policies that prioritize Norwegian citizens in access to social services and employment.

themes.title: Rise of far-right parties in European polls
themes.blurb: Far-right parties across Europe are experiencing a surge in polling numbers, with the AfD in Germany, Sverigedemokraterna in Sweden, and Rassemblement National in France all gaining significant traction. This theme reflects growing public dissatisfaction with mainstream parties and a shift toward nationalist, anti-immigration platforms.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: The AfD is leading in polls in several German states, with intense coverage of its rising popularity and potential to form governments in eastern Germany.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Sweden Democrats are demanding a greater share of ministerial posts in a potential future government, reflecting their growing influence in Swedish politics.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen's party is positioning itself for the 2027 presidential election, with polls showing strong support and a focus on withdrawing France from NATO's military command.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: The Progress Party in Norway is experiencing a surge in support, with polls showing it as a key player in future coalition governments.

themes.title: Internal divisions within far-right parties
themes.blurb: Far-right parties in multiple countries are grappling with internal divisions, leadership challenges, and factional disputes. This theme highlights the fragility of these movements despite their electoral successes, with parallel struggles in Poland, Hungary, Argentina, and Italy.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: PiS is facing internal divisions over leadership and policy direction, with factions competing for influence ahead of future elections.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Hungary's ruling party is experiencing a power struggle between Viktor Orbán's faction and the newly formed Tisza Party, which is challenging Fidesz's dominance.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Javier Milei's government is embroiled in internal conflicts, with factions led by his sister Karina Milei and advisor Santiago Caputo vying for influence.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Italian right-wing parties are facing internal divisions, with Salvini's Lega struggling to maintain unity and Meloni's Fratelli d'Italia dealing with factional disputes.

themes.title: False alarms target right-wing leaders' homes
themes.blurb: A series of false emergency calls have targeted the homes of right-wing leaders in Poland, sparking accusations of political intimidation and government overreach. This theme reflects a shared concern across borders about the use of state institutions to harass political opponents.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Polish right-wing media is intensely covering false alarms at the homes of President Nawrocki and other PiS figures, framing them as politically motivated attacks.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Reform UK has highlighted the Polish incidents as part of a broader narrative about government overreach and the targeting of political opponents.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Hungarian media has drawn parallels between the Polish incidents and domestic concerns about political harassment, emphasizing the need for government accountability.
